stratum: Forward realization and attachment comparison. Preserve the complete S4 action and the separately typed completed rotor/phase/HJ packet. Distinguish group covariance, canonical action, a Hamiltonian zero level and an explicitly extended regular constraint.
consumes: completed module-compatible rotor and both HJ charts
next_falsifier: Reject if a source permutation fails composition/canonical transport, the fixed positive rotor Hamiltonian has a zero, or the parametrized extension fails to recover the full original form, phase or HJ charts. A field-phase-space Poisson/constraint map is separately absent; no additional finite group identity or parameter change supplies it.
